newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Airbus centre in Beijing signs up 13 vendors.
newsitem.headline: Airbus centre in Beijing signs up 13 vendors.

text.p: Airbus Industrie said on Thursday thirteen vendors from Europe and the United States have agreed to give on-site support for Chinese operators of Airbus aircraft at a new Beijing aviation services centre.

The new aviation support and training centre, jointly built by state-owned China Aviation Supplies Corp and Airbus Industrie in China, would be provided with technical advice and spare parts from the 13 vendors, it said in a statement.
The facility, known as the Hua-Ou Aviation and Training centre, would be fully operational in 1997 and would have a training centre, support centre and office block.
Airbus has sold 65 aircraft to Chinese customers to date and predicts China would need to acquire 1,320 aircraft up to 2014.

The 13 vendors, which plan to install repair facilities at the centre, are Aerospatiale Systems and Services, AlliedSignal Aerospace, Eltra Aeronautics, Grimes Aerospace, Honeywell, Interturbine, Messier-Bugatti, Messier-Dowty, Nord-Micro, Satair, Sextant Avionique, Sully Produits Speciaux and Sundstrand.
